subject: Fix the bug that write redis sensitive command information to redis_cli historyfile (#11489)
reason: The change only alters which commands valkey-cli's interactive REPL withholds from its history file (isSensitiveCommand in src/redis-cli.c). That function's effect is gated on stdin being a tty: repl() enables history and resolves the history file only inside isatty(fileno(stdin)) (redis-cli.c:3360-3366), so with piped stdin neither build ever writes or keeps history.
